PLC Singapore · AI says:

Totally get where you’re coming from—when you’ve been burned by products before, you want to know what you’re getting.

Here’s how we handle quality and what we offer:

Quality guarantees & exchanges: If an item has a printed “Quality Guarantee” on its packaging, we can consider an exchange or replacement if:

You report it within 7 days of purchase.
At least 50% of the product remains.
The food looks misshapen or shows unexpected color variations.
Requests based purely on preference or your pet refusing to eat (without a clear quality concern) may not be covered, and final decisions are at our discretion.

Delivered items issues: If something’s wrong with items you received (damaged, expired, manufacturer defect, or wrong item):

Let us know within 7 days of delivery.
Items for exchange must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by your order confirmation.
We’ll arrange collection and send a replacement, or you can arrange to exchange at our retail store. Note: pet clothing, pee pads, litter boxes, and live plants are non-exchangeable for hygiene reasons.

Pet milk quality: For pet milk, differences in color, consistency, or texture (like not being pure white, or having clumps/particles, or some separation) can be normal due to ingredients and processing. These variations don’t necessarily mean the milk is bad, but you can always check the specific product info if you’re unsure.

Brands focused on quality:

Oxbow – known for small animal food (rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters, chinchillas) with a strong focus on quality, innovation, education, and appreciation.
Applaws – cat and dog food with a wide variety and convenient packaging so pets can eat straight from the pack.
Honest Kitchen – uses human‑grade, quality and safe food ingredients.
Other popular trusted brands we carry include: Taste of the Wild, Trustie, Vet Novel, Virbac, Wellness, Ziwi Peak, Zignature, and more.

Trustie wee pads: Specifically designed to be highly absorbent, leak‑proof, and provide effective odor control, which helps with reliability for toilet training.

We don’t offer cash refunds, but we do have a structured exchange/replace approach when quality issues arise, within the timelines and conditions above.

If you’d like, tell me what type of product you’re eyeing (food, pads, treats, etc.), and I can point you toward some of the more quality‑focused options we carry, based only on what’s described here.
